baselineHead: 8ea8537 before editing the download metadata system
notes: This inventory records current artwork byte-transfer paths before production behavior changes.
The runtime automatic artwork cache is still userData/image_cache with type_gameId filename stems.
ArtworkAssetStore exists today for explicit Settings/Creator artwork under user_artwork, but it is not the unified automatic artwork delivery/cache manager.
Renderer surfaces can still receive http/https artwork values and assign them to img src or CSS background-image before or after cache IPCs complete.

auditTable.networkOwner: Injected downloader registered from main.js as _downloadAssetsToCache
auditTable.cacheKey: PlatformSyncAssetWriteBackService._getGameKey(entry), usually id/appid/appId/appName/namespace/title/name, then imageWebpCache.cacheBaseName(type, gameId)
auditTable.retryBehavior: No internal network retry; cover failures are swallowed per entry; secondary failures are swallowed; stale file:// paths are cleared before fallback to remote source.
auditTable.concurrency: coverConcurrency default 10; secondaryConcurrency default 2; batchSize default 20; secondary phase is fire-and-forget after cover phase write flush.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Keep the cover-first semantic contract, but replace the injected downloader with the unified ArtworkDeliveryManager scheduler. Covers should be high priority and awaited; hero/logo should be scheduled without duplicate body downloads.

auditTable.networkOwner: Baddel metadata API for metadata; injected _downloadAssetsToCache for returned artwork URLs
auditTable.cacheKey: Synced library identity passed to _downloadAssetsToCache; legacy filename stem type_gameId
auditTable.retryBehavior: Baddel API has batch/per-item retry; artwork downloader itself has no retry beyond cache hit short-circuit and failure fallback to remote URL.
auditTable.concurrency: Depends on enrichment flow; cacheLibraryCoversFirst uses 10/2 for cover/secondary; direct import write-back uses Promise.all over asset object.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Separate sync metadata import from artwork transfer. Sync should persist remote candidates and enqueue artwork jobs instead of downloading during account sync completion.

auditTable.networkOwner: services/imageWebpCache.downloadToCacheAsWebp
auditTable.cacheKey: imageWebpCache.cacheBaseName(type, gameId)
auditTable.retryBehavior: No retry; returns original URL on failure; skips falsy URLs; downloads all requested asset types with Promise.all.
auditTable.concurrency: Unbounded per call by Object.entries(assets).map(Promise.all); upstream callers provide broader queueing.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Turn this function into a compatibility adapter over ArtworkDeliveryManager.requestMany while preserving return shape { cover, hero, logo }.

auditTable.networkOwner: https.get in _fetchBuffer
auditTable.cacheKey: Caller-provided baseName, normally imageWebpCache.cacheBaseName(type, gameId)
auditTable.retryBehavior: Follows up to 5 redirects; no retry after timeout, HTTP failure, content-type failure, private-host block, oversize response, or tiny file rejection; returns null on failure.
auditTable.concurrency: No internal queue or dedupe; every caller invocation may perform a body transfer if the named file is absent.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Retire as the direct downloader after ArtworkDeliveryManager owns fetch, telemetry, content addressing, validation, retry policy, and bandwidth budgets.

auditTable.networkOwner: services/imageWebpCache.downloadToCacheAsWebp
auditTable.cacheKey: imageWebpCache.cacheBaseName(type, gameId)
auditTable.retryBehavior: Validates file:// existence; otherwise one download attempt; returns original URL on failure.
auditTable.concurrency: One transfer per IPC invocation; no IPC-level dedupe.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Keep IPC compatibility but route to ArtworkDeliveryManager; return cached local file URL when available, otherwise a controlled pending/fallback result instead of causing duplicate renderer requests.

auditTable.networkOwner: services/imageWebpCache.downloadToCacheAsWebp
assetTypes: any object key supplied by renderer
auditTable.cacheKey: imageWebpCache.cacheBaseName(type, gameId)
auditTable.retryBehavior: One attempt per asset; per-asset failure is swallowed and original URL is returned.
auditTable.concurrency: Promise.all across every supplied asset key; no global budget or dedupe.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Route through ArtworkDeliveryManager.requestMany with per-type priorities and coalescing by source URL/content hash.

auditTable.networkOwner: none
auditTable.cacheKey: imageWebpCache.cacheBaseName(type, gameId), matched by filename prefix
auditTable.retryBehavior: No network; returns null for missing cache dir, missing match, stat error, or files smaller than 512 bytes.
auditTable.concurrency: Synchronous filesystem lookup per IPC invocation.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Teach lookup to query the unified manifest/content-addressed cache first, then legacy image_cache during migration.

auditTable.networkOwner: none
auditTable.cacheKey: Legacy image_cache filenames matching /^(cover|hero|logo)_(.+?)\.(webp|jpg|png|gif)$/
auditTable.retryBehavior: No network; unlink failures are skipped.
auditTable.concurrency: Synchronous directory scan and unlink loop.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Replace with automatic cache GC for the manager cache only; never prune user_artwork.

auditTable.networkOwner: metadataResolutionManager/baddelApi for metadata; injected imageDownloadFn for artwork bytes
auditTable.cacheKey: game.id passed to injected imageDownloadFn, currently legacy type_gameId files
auditTable.retryBehavior: MRM status/cooldown controls metadata retries; asset caching errors are non-fatal and remote URLs are persisted as fallback.
auditTable.concurrency: Serial game loop with 300 ms throttle; imageDownloadFn may download cover/hero/logo concurrently.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Keep metadata resolution in the pipeline, but enqueue artwork work through the manager with background priority and persist only final local or managed fallback state.

auditTable.function: runBackgroundMetadataPipeline hero and logo backfill branches
auditTable.networkOwner: Injected imageDownloadFn when cached metadata has remote hero/logo URLs
auditTable.cacheKey: game.id passed to injected imageDownloadFn
auditTable.retryBehavior: Per-game try/catch; failed hero download falls back to remote URL; logo errors are swallowed and loop continues.
auditTable.concurrency: Serial pipeline path; imageDownloadFn owns per-asset concurrency.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Manager should classify this as background repair with stale-cache awareness and bounded retry windows.

auditTable.networkOwner: baddelApi.lookupGame for metadata; engine.backgroundDownload for artwork persistence
auditTable.cacheKey: game.id through engine.backgroundDownload/updateGameMetadata; current BackgroundDownloadService does not download bytes itself
auditTable.retryBehavior: Per-game metadata lookup errors are swallowed; non-file CDN URLs are treated as not missing and are not re-fetched.
auditTable.concurrency: Serial loop over stored games.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Replace backgroundDownload no-op URL pass-through with manager-backed cover repair or retire this path after cache-first startup owns repair.

auditTable.networkOwner: none currently; resolveCachedUrl is a no-op returning the remote URL
auditTable.cacheKey: none for bytes; writes final URLs into JsonGameRepository by gameId
auditTable.retryBehavior: No network retry; outer errors are caught and logged.
auditTable.concurrency: Promise.all over cover/hero/logo URL resolution, but no byte transfer today.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Either wire to ArtworkDeliveryManager or narrow this service to metadata DB write-back after manager resolves assets.

auditTable.networkOwner: metadataResolutionManager for metadata; injected backgroundDownload for artwork write-back
auditTable.cacheKey: temporary/stable manual game id passed to backgroundDownload
auditTable.retryBehavior: Depends on metadata resolver and backgroundDownload; add manual awaits backgroundDownload before returning hydrated game.
auditTable.concurrency: Single add flow.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Keep await semantics, but let backgroundDownload/manager produce local artwork before the returned game is rendered where practical.

auditTable.networkOwner: renderer calls window.electronAPI.getMetadata, then cacheAllAssets IPC
auditTable.cacheKey: game.id for getCachedImage/cacheAllAssets and localStorage cover_/hero_/logo_ keys
auditTable.retryBehavior: Server-pending metadata retries up to 3 times with 4 second delay; cacheAllAssets failure falls back to remote URLs.
auditTable.concurrency: imageQueue activeRequests capped at 3; cacheAllAssets downloads all assets concurrently in main.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Make first render cache-first and replace renderer metadata-triggered artwork fetches with manager requests for visible cards only.

auditTable.networkOwner: Disk phase has none; network phase delegates to _suggHydrateArt in suggestions.js
auditTable.cacheKey: g.id and suggestion art localStorage key baddelSuggestionArtCache
auditTable.retryBehavior: Disk lookup only in warm phase; stale file URLs are removed.
auditTable.concurrency: _RTIA_DISK_CONCURRENCY = 4; network follow-up is fire-and-forget.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Keep disk warm as first paint path, but route network hydration through the manager with visible-item priority and in-flight dedupe.

auditTable.networkOwner: renderer calls window.electronAPI.getMetadata, then cacheAllAssets IPC
auditTable.cacheKey: _suggKey(g), g.id, baddelSuggestionArtCache, and legacy image_cache type_gameId files
auditTable.retryBehavior: Pending metadata retries twice after 3500 ms; cacheAllAssets errors are swallowed.
auditTable.concurrency: _SUGG_HYDRATE_CONCURRENCY controls metadata hydration; cacheAllAssets uses Promise.all in main.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Use manager prewarm for visible RTIA rows and stop snapshotting remote URLs as long-lived art cache when local cache is pending.

auditTable.networkOwner: renderer calls window.electronAPI.getMetadata, then cacheAllAssets IPC
auditTable.cacheKey: game.id and localStorage cover_/hero_/logo_ keys
auditTable.retryBehavior: No explicit retry; cacheAllAssets failure falls back to remote metadata URL.
auditTable.concurrency: Per-card async call; no shared queue beyond downstream IPC downloader.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Treat Jump Back In hero as high-priority visible artwork in ArtworkDeliveryManager and ignore stale responses after card/game changes.

auditTable.caller: Game Details metadata fallback and cache recovery
auditTable.networkOwner: renderer calls getMetadata and cacheAllAssets IPC
auditTable.cacheKey: game.id for cacheAllAssets/getCachedImage and canonical V2 fallback write-back
auditTable.retryBehavior: getMetadata is bounded with timeout in fallback; cacheAllAssets failure persists remote fallback URLs.
auditTable.concurrency: Per open details page; no central artwork queue.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Give Game Details top priority, cache-first hydration, stale navigation guards, and a single manager request per asset URL/game identity.

auditTable.caller: Game Settings and Creator explicit artwork
auditTable.networkOwner: JsonGameRepository ArtworkAssetStore for explicit setGameArtwork values; cacheAllAssets only for reset/server fallback recovery
auditTable.cacheKey: canonical game identity in user_artwork for explicit artwork; game.id for legacy reset cache fallback
auditTable.retryBehavior: Explicit data/file/remote materialization errors surface through setGameArtwork; reset fallback cacheAllAssets errors fall back to remote metadata values.
auditTable.concurrency: User-driven single mutation.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Keep explicit user artwork separate from automatic artwork cache. Manager must never prune or overwrite user_artwork and must not take ownership of Settings/Creator choices.

auditTable.caller: All Games platform account cover side-effect
auditTable.networkOwner: renderer calls cacheImage/getCachedImage/getMetadata IPC
auditTable.cacheKey: game ids and alternate allIds through _agGetCachedImageAnyKey; localStorage cover_/hero_/logo_ keys
auditTable.retryBehavior: Disk cache checked before getMetadata; cacheImage failure leaves remote fallback; localStorage http URL can be used as immediate fallback.
auditTable.concurrency: Per visible card/pipeline events; no global artwork byte budget.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Replace renderer side-effect download calls with manager requests and remove long-lived http localStorage fallbacks after managed cache is authoritative.

auditTable.caller: All Games cover cached event patch
auditTable.networkOwner: none in listener; receives file URLs emitted by platform sync cover-first service
auditTable.cacheKey: payload id/appid/title/namespace matched to card records
auditTable.retryBehavior: No network; skips creator-owned artwork and stale/unusable cover patches.
auditTable.concurrency: Event-driven DOM patching.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Keep as a compatibility event or replace with manager asset-ready events that include canonical identity and asset type.

auditTable.networkOwner: none
auditTable.cacheKey: gameId and type passed to getCachedImage
auditTable.retryBehavior: No network; logs and returns empty string on lookup error.
auditTable.concurrency: Per overlay render.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Query manager cache manifest/read model instead of legacy image_cache while preserving no-network overlay behavior.

auditTable.networkOwner: none for direct lookup; may depend on suggestion hydration elsewhere
auditTable.cacheKey: id and type hero passed to getCachedImage; _suggArtCache
auditTable.retryBehavior: No network in cache fallback; errors are swallowed.
auditTable.concurrency: Per roulette candidate.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Use manager manifest for hero availability and avoid direct remote hero display when managed local asset is pending and visible priority can fetch it.

auditTable.networkOwner: Chromium renderer when assigned http/https URLs directly

auditTable.retryBehavior: DOM onerror fallbacks and failedImageIds in some helpers; no shared retry policy or byte budget.
auditTable.concurrency: Browser-controlled per visible image/background; can bypass main-process downloader.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Add a renderer guard/read-model rule so game artwork surfaces prefer file:// manager URLs and request missing remote assets through IPC instead of assigning remote artwork directly. Exclude intentional non-artwork URLs such as YouTube embeds and feedback form fetch.

auditTable.networkOwner: none; copies existing Steam avatarcache file into image_cache

auditTable.concurrency: Renderer-call driven.
auditTable.migrationPlan: Preserve compatibility while adding manager-backed IPC names or routing existing names to manager. Keep explicit user artwork APIs separate from automatic cache APIs.
